issues.detail: Hebrew בְּסַעַר בְּיוֹם סוּפָה means 'in a storm on the day of the whirlwind' (or 'in a tempest in the day of the storm-wind'); the Chinese renders it as '在風暴之日，隨著曠野的風暴' which adds '曠野的' (of the wilderness) not present in the Hebrew, and the phrase '隨著' (along with) misrepresents the preposition 'in/with' as accompaniment rather than the manner of the fire's destruction.
